# THE TERRAFORMING ALMANAC [italic]Long range facts for a long range life. Compiled by AtmoCast from processor logs, colony charters and Marge's notebook.[/italic]
## HOW LONG UNTIL IT IS NICE OUT? A standard atmosphere processor takes twenty to fifty years to bring a world up to shirtsleeve conditions. Your colony charter has a target date on page three. Every colonist reads page three. Nobody believes page three.
## PROCESSOR MILESTONES - [bold]Year 1.[/bold] Air technically breathable for minutes at a time. Do not test this. - [bold]Year 5.[/bold] First clouds that the processor did not make on purpose. - [bold]Year 10.[/bold] First proper rain. Colonists stand in it. Somebody cries. It is usually the administrator. - [bold]Year 20.[/bold] Weather. Real weather, with fronts and forecasts. Marge gets a pay rise. - [bold]Year 30 and on.[/bold] Gardens outside. Children who complain about the weather like it is a right.
## FOLK WEATHER WISDOM OF THE FRONTIER - Red sky at night, the processor is overheating. - When the Joes stop sweeping, a storm is coming. - If the dogs will not go out, neither should you. - If the dropship will not land, neither will the supplies. - Quiet in the vents, fair weather. Noise in the vents, see your administrator.
## THIS MONTH IN WEATHER HISTORY 2179: a terraforming colony on a small moon reported a severe storm, then stopped reporting anything. The AtmoCast archive shows clear skies on that colony for the next three months. The archive also shows a very large thermal event. AtmoCast has filed this under weather, because it was asked to.
